rows.label: US dollars per British pound, 2019 yearly average

source.title: US Internal Revenue Service, Yearly average currency exchange rates
source.note: Table row United Kingdom (Pound), column 2019: 0.784 pounds per dollar; 1 / 0.784 = 1.2755 dollars per pound (archived copy of 29 December 2021).

rows.explainer: The IRS's yearly average for 2019, the one source every exchange rate on the site uses. Models that import a cost stated in pounds for a year's spending convert it to dollars at that year's average, so every model counts per dollar.
